title: Bandwidth sensitivity and RDD robustness checks

llm_response.content:
## 1. Identification Strategy

**Method: Regression Discontinuity Design (RDD)**

The Russell 1000/2000 reconstitution provides a sharp cutoff based on end-of-May market capitalization rankings. Firms just below the cutoff (ranked ~1001+) are assigned to the Russell 2000, while firms just above (ranked ~1000 and below) remain in the Russell 1000. Since Russell 2000 index funds mechanically hold larger positions in their constituent stocks (due to value-weighting in a smaller index), assignment to the Russell 2000 should increase institutional ownership.

**Key assumptions:**
1. **No precise manipulation at the cutoff:** Firms cannot precisely control their end-of-May market cap rank to manipulate index assignment. This is testable via a McCrary density test.
2. **Continuity of potential outcomes:** All other determinants of institutional ownership vary smoothly through the cutoff, so any discontinuity in the outcome is attributable to index membership.
3. **Local randomization near cutoff:** Firms just above and just below the cutoff are comparable in all dimensions except treatment.

**Robustness checks:**
- **Bandwidth sensitivity:** Estimate across multiple bandwidths to ensure results aren't driven by bandwidth choice.
- **Polynomial order sensitivity:** Compare local linear, quadratic, and cubic specifications.
- **Placebo cutoffs:** Run the RDD at false cutoff points where no discontinuity should exist.

## 2. R Code

```r
# =============================================================================
# RDD Analysis: Russell 1000/2000 Index Reconstitution and Institutional Ownership
# =============================================================================

# Load required packages
if (!require("rdrobust")) install.packages("rdrobust", repos="https://cloud.r-project.org")
if (!require("rddensity")) install.packages("rddensity", repos="https://cloud.r-project.org")
library(rdrobust)
library(rddensity)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Read and explore data
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
df <- read.csv("experiments/exp_b/data/s29_data.csv")

cat("=== DATA SUMMARY ===\n")
cat("N observations:", nrow(df), "\n")
cat("N treated (Russell 2000):", sum(df$treated), "\n")
cat("N control (Russell 1000):", sum(df$treated == 0), "\n\n")

summary(df)
cat("\n")

# The cutoff is at 0.5: running_var < 0.5 → Russell 1000; running_var >= 0.5 → Russell 2000
cutoff <- 0.5

# Verify treatment assignment matches the cutoff
mismatches <- sum((df$running_var >= cutoff) != df$treated)
cat("Treatment-cutoff mismatches:", mismatches, "\n\n")

# Basic means comparison near cutoff
bw_narrow <- 0.1
near_left  <- df$y[df$running_var >= (cutoff - bw_narrow) & df$running_var < cutoff]
near_right <- df$y[df$running_var >= cutoff & df$running_var <= (cutoff + bw_narrow)]
cat("=== SIMPLE MEANS COMPARISON (bandwidth = ", bw_narrow, ") ===\n")
cat("Mean Y (Russell 1000, just below cutoff):", round(mean(near_left), 4), 
    " (N=", length(near_left), ")\n")
cat("Mean Y (Russell 2000, just above cutoff):", round(mean(near_right), 4), 
    " (N=", length(near_right), ")\n")
cat("Raw difference:", round(mean(near_right) - mean(near_left), 4), "\n\n")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. McCrary Density Test (Manipulation Check)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
cat("=== McCRARY DENSITY TEST ===\n")
density_test <- tryCatch({
  rddensity(df$running_var, c = cutoff)
}, error = function(e) {
  cat("Density test error:", e$message, "\n")
  NULL
})

if (!is.null(density_test)) {
  cat("T-statistic:", round(density_test$test$t_jk, 4), "\n")
  cat("P-value:", round(density_test$test$p_jk, 4), "\n")
  if (density_test$test$p_jk > 0.05) {
    cat("→ No evidence of manipulation at the cutoff (good)\n\n")
  } else {
    cat("→ Warning: possible manipulation at cutoff\n\n")
  }
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Main RDD Estimate using rdrobust (MSE-optimal bandwidth)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
cat("=== MAIN RDD ESTIMATE (rdrobust, MSE-optimal BW) ===\n")
rd_main <- rdrobust(y = df$y, x = df$running_var, c = cutoff, 
                     kernel = "triangular", p = 1, bwselect = "mserd")
summary(rd_main)

cat("\nMain estimate (local linear):\n")
cat("  Coefficient:", round(rd_main$coef[1], 4), "\n")
cat("  Robust 95% CI: [", round(rd_main$ci[3,1], 4), ",", round(rd_main$ci[3,2], 4), "]\n")
cat("  Robust p-value:", round(rd_main$pv[3], 4), "\n")
cat("  Optimal bandwidth:", round(rd_main$bws[1,1], 4), "\n")
cat("  Effective N (left/right):", rd_main$N_h[1], "/", rd_main$N_h[2], "\n\n")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. BANDWIDTH SENSITIVITY ANALYSIS
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
cat("=== BANDWIDTH SENSITIVITY ANALYSIS ===\n")

optimal_bw <- rd_main$bws[1,1]
bw_grid <- c(0.05, 0.08, 0.10, 0.12, 0.15, 0.20, 0.25, 
             round(optimal_bw * 0.5, 3), 
             round(optimal_bw * 0.75, 3),
             round(optimal_bw, 3), 
             round(optimal_bw * 1.25, 3),
             round(optimal_bw * 1.5, 3),
             round(optimal_bw * 2.0, 3),
             0.30, 0.40, 0.50)
bw_grid <- sort(unique(bw_grid))

bw_results <- data.frame(
  bandwidth = numeric(),
  estimate = numeric(),
  se_robust = numeric(),
  pval_robust = numeric(),
  ci_lower = numeric(),
  ci_upper = numeric(),
  n_left = numeric(),
  n_right = numeric()
)

for (bw in bw_grid) {
  tryCatch({
    rd_bw <- rdrobust(y = df$y, x = df$running_var, c = cutoff,
                       kernel = "triangular", p = 1, h = bw)
    bw_results <- rbind(bw_results, data.frame(
      bandwidth = bw,
      estimate = rd_bw$coef[1],
      se_robust = rd_bw$se[3],
      pval_robust = rd_bw$pv[3],
      ci_lower = rd_bw$ci[3,1],
      ci_upper = rd_bw$ci[3,2],
      n_left = rd_bw$N_h[1],
      n_right = rd_bw$N_h[2]
    ))
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("  Bandwidth", bw, "failed:", e$message, "\n")
  })
}

cat("\nBandwidth Sensitivity Results:\n")
cat(sprintf("%-10s %-10s %-10s %-10s %-22s %-8s\n", 
            "BW", "Estimate", "SE(rob)", "p-val", "95% CI (robust)", "N_eff"))
cat(strrep("-", 75), "\n")
for (i in 1:nrow(bw_results)) {
  r <- bw_results[i,]
  marker <- ifelse(abs(r$bandwidth - optimal_bw) < 0.001, " <-- optimal", "")
  cat(sprintf("%-10.3f %-10.4f %-10.4f %-10.4f [%7.4f, %7.4f]  %-4d/%-4d%s\n",
              r$bandwidth, r$estimate, r$se_robust, r$pval_robust,
              r$ci_lower, r$ci_upper, r$n_left, r$n_right, marker))
}

# Check if sign is stable
cat("\nSign stability: All estimates positive?", all(bw_results$estimate > 0), "\n")
cat("Significance stability: All p < 0.05?", all(bw_results$pval_robust < 0.05), "\n")
cat("Range of estimates:", round(min(bw_results$estimate), 4), "to", 
    round(max(bw_results$estimate), 4), "\n\n")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. POLYNOMIAL ORDER SENSITIVITY
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
cat("=== POLYNOMIAL ORDER SENSITIVITY ===\n")

poly_results <- data.frame(
  order = integer(),
  estimate = numeric(),
  se_robust = numeric(),
  pval_robust = numeric(),
  bandwidth = numeric()
)

for (p_order in 1:4) {
  tryCatch({
    rd_poly <- rdrobust(y = df$y, x = df$running_var, c = cutoff,
                         kernel = "triangular", p = p_order, bwselect = "mserd")
    poly_results <- rbind(poly_results, data.frame(
      order = p_order,
      estimate = rd_poly$coef[1],
      se_robust = rd_poly$se[3],
      pval_robust = rd_poly$pv[3],
      bandwidth = rd_poly$bws[1,1]
    ))
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("  Polynomial order", p_order, "failed:", e$message, "\n")
  })
}

cat(sprintf("%-8s %-10s %-10s %-10s %-10s\n", "Order", "Estimate", "SE(rob)", "p-val", "Opt BW"))
cat(strrep("-", 50), "\n")
for (i in 1:nrow(poly_results)) {
  r <- poly_results[i,]
  cat(sprintf("%-8d %-10.4f %-10.4f %-10.4f %-10.4f\n",
              r$order, r$estimate, r$se_robust, r$pval_robust, r$bandwidth))
}
cat("\n")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. KERNEL SENSITIVITY
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
cat("=== KERNEL SENSITIVITY ===\n")

for (kern in c("triangular", "epanechnikov", "uniform")) {
  tryCatch({
    rd_kern <- rdrobust(y = df$y, x = df$running_var, c = cutoff,
                         kernel = kern, p = 1, bwselect = "mserd")
    cat(sprintf("Kernel: %-15s  Estimate: %7.4f  SE: %7.4f  p-val: %7.4f  BW: %7.4f\n",
                kern, rd_kern$coef[1], rd_kern$se[3], rd_kern$pv[3], rd_kern$bws[1,1]))
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("Kernel", kern, "failed:", e$message, "\n")
  })
}
cat("\n")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. PLACEBO CUTOFF TESTS
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
cat("=== PLACEBO CUTOFF TESTS ===\n")
cat("(Testing for false discontinuities at non-cutoff points)\n\n")

placebo_cutoffs <- c(0.20, 0.25, 0.30, 0.35, 0.40, 0.60, 0.65, 0.70, 0.75, 0.80)

placebo_results <- data.frame(
  cutoff_val = numeric(),
  estimate = numeric(),
  se_robust = numeric(),
  pval_robust = numeric(),
  significant = logical()
)

for (pc in placebo_cutoffs) {
  tryCatch({
    rd_placebo <- rdrobust(y = df$y, x = df$running_var, c = pc,
                            kernel = "triangular", p = 1, bwselect = "mserd")
    placebo_results <- rbind(placebo_results, data.frame(
      cutoff_val = pc,
      estimate = rd_placebo$coef[1],
      se_robust = rd_placebo$se[3],
      pval_robust = rd_placebo$pv[3],
      significant = rd_placebo$pv[3] < 0.05
    ))
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("  Placebo cutoff", pc, "failed:", e$message, "\n")
  })
}

cat(sprintf("%-12s %-10s %-10s %-10s %-10s\n", "Cutoff", "Estimate", "SE(rob)", "p-val", "Sig?"))
cat(strrep("-", 55), "\n")
for (i in 1:nrow(placebo_results)) {
  r <- placebo_results[i,]
  cat(sprintf("%-12.2f %-10.4f %-10.4f %-10.4f %-10s\n",
              r$cutoff_val, r$estimate, r$se_robust, r$pval_robust,
              ifelse(r$significant, "YES *", "no")))
}

cat("\nTrue cutoff (0.50) estimate:", round(rd_main$coef[1], 4), 
    "  p-value:", round(rd_main$pv[3], 4), "\n")
cat("Placebo cutoffs significant at 5%:", sum(placebo_results$significant), 
    "out of", nrow(placebo_results), "\n\n")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. PARAMETRIC RDD (OLS) as additional robustness
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
cat("=== PARAMETRIC RDD (OLS) ROBUSTNESS ===\n")

df$rv_centered <- df$running_var - cutoff

# Model 1: Linear, full sample
m1 <- lm(y ~ treated * rv_centered, data = df)
cat("\nModel 1 - Linear, full sample:\n")
cat("  Treatment effect:", round(coef(m1)["treated"], 4), 
    "  p-value:", round(summary(m1)$coefficients["treated", 4], 4), "\n")

# Model 2: Quadratic, full sample
m2 <- lm(y ~ treated * (rv_centered + I(rv_centered^2)), data = df)
cat("Model 2 - Quadratic, full sample:\n")
cat("  Treatment effect:", round(coef(m2)["treated"], 4),
    "  p-value:", round(summary(m2)$coefficients["treated", 4], 4), "\n")

# Model 3: Linear, near cutoff only
df_near <- df[df$near_cutoff == 1, ]
if (nrow(df_near) > 20) {
  m3 <- lm(y ~ treated * rv_centered, data = df_near)
  cat("Model 3 - Linear, near_cutoff subsample (N=", nrow(df_near), "):\n")
  cat("  Treatment effect:", round(coef(m3)["treated"], 4),

_ground_truth.identification_strategy: Sharp RDD — rank cutoff; rdrobust with CCT bandwidth; donut-hole robustness; placebo cutoffs
_ground_truth.conclusion_detail: Russell 2000 membership increases institutional ownership; robust to bandwidth choice
